name: Auckland
housing: Auckland renters live in wooden villas and bungalows, townhouses and city apartments.

localRules.text: Landlords in New Zealand must give a receipt for the bond and lodge it with Tenancy Services within 23 working days of receiving it.

tenantHelp.name: Tenancy Services
tenantHelp.what: government tenancy service: bonds, rights and the Tenancy Tribunal

climate: Check for damp and mould and test the heating and extractor fans; Auckland is mild but humid.
fact: Many older Auckland rentals are wooden villas, which can be cold and damp in winter.
